d:
After almost 15 to 20 years, I returned to a small village near Chakai in Bihar, a place that holds many childhood memories for me. But this wasn’t just an ordinary visit. This was a place I remembered as a very remote and troubled area, once known for Naxal activity. Growing up, I used to feel scared whenever I travelled through this region.
Coming back after so many years, I wanted to see how much things had changed. What does this village look like today? How have the people, their lifestyle, and everyday life changed over the years?
